message.content: {"predictors": [{"name": "Short-Term Earnings Accrual Variability", "construction": "Compute the standard deviation of quarterly earnings accruals (difference between net income and cash flow from operations) over the past 8 quarters, scaled by average total assets.", "rationale": "High variability in accruals may indicate earnings management or operational instability, which could be mispriced by investors.", "higher_returns_for": "stocks with high earnings accrual variability"}, {"name": "Recent Employee Growth Rate", "construction": "Calculate the percentage change in the number of employees reported in the most recent annual report compared to 2 years prior.", "rationale": "Rapid changes in workforce may signal underlying shifts in firm growth prospects or over-expansion.", "higher_returns_for": "stocks with low recent employee growth rates"}, {"name": "Supplier Concentration Ratio", "construction": "For firms disclosing their top 5 suppliers in 10-K filings, sum the percentage of total purchases attributed to those suppliers.", "rationale": "High supplier concentration may signal vulnerability to supply shocks or bargaining power issues, impacting future returns.", "higher_returns_for": "stocks with low supplier concentration ratios"}, {"name": "Dividend Smoothing Persistence", "construction": "Measure the number of consecutive years with unchanged annual dividends per share over the past decade.", "rationale": "Persistent dividend smoothing may signal conservative management and information asymmetry.", "higher_returns_for": "stocks with longer streaks of unchanged dividends"}, {"name": "Deferred Tax Asset Growth", "construction": "Calculate the percentage change in deferred tax assets over the trailing 3 years, scaled by total assets.", "rationale": "Aggressive use of deferred tax assets may indicate earnings management or lower future profitability.", "higher_returns_for": "stocks with low deferred tax asset growth"}, {"name": "Off-Balance Sheet Operating Leases", "construction": "Estimate the present value of future minimum lease payments for operating leases, scaled by total assets, using footnote disclosures.", "rationale": "High off-balance sheet leverage may be underappreciated by the market and signal higher risk.", "higher_returns_for": "stocks with high off-balance sheet operating leases"}, {"name": "Related Party Transaction Intensity", "construction": "Count the number of related party transactions disclosed in the most recent 10-K, standardized by total assets.", "rationale": "Frequent related party transactions may reflect weak governance and potential for misappropriation, affecting returns.", "higher_returns_for": "stocks with low related party transaction intensity"}, {"name": "R&D Capitalization Ratio", "construction": "For firms that capitalize R&D, calculate the ratio of capitalized R&D to total reported R&D over the past 3 years.", "rationale": "A high ratio may indicate aggressive capitalization and overstatement of assets, affecting future returns.", "higher_returns_for": "stocks with low R&D capitalization ratios"}, {"name": "Seasonal Inventory Build-up", "construction": "Measure the average change in inventory from Q3 to Q4 over the past 5 years, scaled by total annual sales.", "rationale": "Predictable seasonal inventory swings may indicate inefficient inventory management or exposure to demand shocks.", "higher_returns_for": "stocks with low seasonal inventory build-up"}, {"name": "Pre-announcement Drift", "construction": "Calculate the average abnormal return in the 30 days before quarterly earnings announcements over the past 4 quarters.", "rationale": "Stocks with consistent pre-announcement drift may be subject to information leakage or sentiment-driven price moves.", "higher_returns_for": "stocks with high positive pre-announcement drift"}]}
